text: lucy: quick design huddle: three tiny decisions for the dark console before the next patch — inline code contrast, legend treatment for overlay charts, and microcopy in the model dropdown. dan: paste the current tokens please so we can run quick checks. sophie: also noticed code blocks look fine but inline tokens disappear on low-brightness phones. lucy: current snapshot: ``` --bg: #0a0b0c --surface-1: #0f1113 --surface-2: #141617 --muted-text: #98a1a6 --accent-1: #74c9ff --accent-2: #7fe0b5 --code-bg: #0b0d0f --code-fg: #dbeefb ``` dan: `#dbeefb` on `#0b0d0f` runs ~4.3:1 by my head. contrast-bot will flag. Suggest `#eaf8ff` or lift code-bg to #0e1012. contrast-bot: auto-check: `#dbeefb` on `#0b0d0f` = 4.3:1 (target >=4.5). Rec: `#eaf8ff` => 4.7:1. sophie: proposal: keep code block bg as-is to preserve mood, update inline token to `#eaf8ff` and add 1px inset border `rgba(255,255,255,0.03)` for better separation. mike: for charts: overlay mode (latency + p95 + errors) needs legend that doesn't obscure content. Option A: floating pill per-item. Option B: single translucent bar behind legend. I prefer B for compactness. dan: B if the bar is full-width and uses `rgba(4,6,8,0.78)` so it reads across panels. Also add a thin divider between legend items for scan. sophie: accessibility: error series should not be only red; use dashed line + warm hue. Also test for Deuteranopia simulation. contrast-bot: check: proposed legend bg `rgba(4,6,8,0.78)` on `--surface-2` => passes 6.9:1. lucy: microcopy: Model dropdown currently says "Select a model" 0 users sometimes think it's about deployment. Suggest "Select model (serving)" or add tooltip "choose model for inference". dan: tooltip is less invasive. "Choose model for inference" fine. Keep strings short for translations. sophie: tiny CSS snippet to test inline token: ``` token ``` mike: legend CSS: ``` .legend-bar { background: rgba(4,6,8,0.78); padding:6px 8px; border-radius:6px; display:flex; gap:8px; } .legend-item { border-left:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04); padding-left:8px } ``` dan: focus ring nit: dark-theme buttons use a faint 3px ring; increase alpha to 0.18 and 4px radius for keyboard nav. sophie: agree, keyboard users report it's easy to miss. Also log a brief note in accessibility docs explaining the inline-code change (we raised contrast to meet AA for body text). contrast-bot: reminder: run `design-kit color-a11y --threshold 4.5` and attach the report to the PR. lucy: action items: 1) sophie to update inline token to `#eaf8ff` and add inset border in tokens file (today). 2) mike to prototype legend bar + divider in storybook (EOD). 3) dan to update tooltip copy key and add note for translators. 4) lucy to add short rationale to /docs/accessibility linking contrast output. sophie: will run Deuteranopia sim as part of the mock. dan: i'll open the i18n PR after tooltip string lands here. lucy: thanks team 0 will follow up with PR links in this thread. :sparkles:
